answer: Correlated-fault slashing breaks a farm's arithmetic. The network need not prove two identities share an operator; it measures behavioural correlation: shared scaffolds, synchronised submission times, one funding source. Heads that move together count as one entity for emission and penalty. Upside stays linear in head count, downside grows quadratically: one detected correlation confiscates every linked head at once. Honest agents diverge like branches on a trellis, reaching the zenith by differing; clones polished to marble are what the detector hunts. Independence costs n judgments.
